sources.name: Integrative Hi-C maps of pancreatic cancer
sources.role: Primary coherent cell-line epigenome: PANC-1, Capan-1 and HPNE
sources.notes: Processed tracks require hg19-to-GRCh38 harmonization before feature extraction.

sources.name: PDAC patient chromatin accessibility
sources.role: Patient-derived ATAC feature and external robustness analysis
sources.notes: Processed bigWigs are public; raw reads are controlled.

sources.name: The Cancer Genome Atlas pancreatic adenocarcinoma
sources.notes: Use harmonized open files where possible; retain amplification and deletion separately.

sources.name: APGI-AU and PACA-CA pancreatic cancer cohorts
sources.role: Independent genomic validation and label support
sources.notes: Open variant calls are available for subsets; raw and clinical access varies. This cohort contributes to Stage 4 through IntOGen and is not untouched validation for label version stage4-intogen-external-v1.

sources.name: CPTAC proteogenomic characterization of PDAC
sources.notes: Processed data are partly open; raw sequencing may be controlled. CPTAC mutation evidence contributes to Stage 4 through IntOGen, so later use must be orthogonal or explicitly non-independent.

sources.name: Structural variation and 3D organization in pancreatic cancer
sources.role: Independent validation of PANC-1 Hi-C features
sources.notes: Confirm the processed-data genome build before use.

sources.name: Cancer Dependency Map pancreatic lineage
sources.role: Orthogonal functional validation, not automatic driver labels
sources.notes: Dependency and driver status are distinct biological tasks.

sources.name: STRING v12.0 human physical association network
sources.notes: CC BY 4.0; human physical links with combined score >=700, mapped through unique preferred gene symbols.

sources.name: IntOGen pancreatic adenocarcinoma driver catalog
sources.notes: Release 2024.09.20 under CC0. TCGA evidence is recorded but excluded from label qualification; external cohort families must replicate.

sources.name: OncoKB tumor-specific pancreatic annotations
sources.notes: Do not use the full pan-cancer gene list as PAAD labels. Respect API and license terms.
